mintAuthority.summary: EUROP uses UUPS token proxies on Ethereum, Polygon, Avalanche, and Plasma, Schuman's issuer account on XRPL, and a Token-2022 mint on Solana. The EVM deployments use chain-local admin and master-minter Safes; XRPL uses its issuer quorum; Solana uses a 1-of-3 Token-2022 mint-authority multisig.

controls.label: EUROP Ethereum owner / DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE Safe
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25530884, owner() and the sole DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE member were 0xe1f9754f. The verified source gates _authorizeUpgrade with DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and lets that role administer MASTER_MINTER_ROLE and minter allowances. This Safe is 3-of-4 on-chain.

controls.label: EUROP Ethereum MASTER_MINTER_ROLE Safe
controls.capDescription: MASTER_MINTER_ROLE bypasses the per-minter allowance in mint(); the Safe can also administer minter allowances.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25530884, this 2-of-4 Safe was the sole MASTER_MINTER_ROLE member. EUROPToken.mint() permits MASTER_MINTER_ROLE callers to mint without consuming minterAllowed.

controls.label: EUROP Solana Token-2022 mint-authority multisig
controls.evidence: At finalized Solana slot 434569236, getAccountInfo(jsonParsed) identifies EUROP mint euro5sNHrZC2wu2RoLvy6xxoVMc3Qnd1vjxoWf4MftA as a 6-decimal Token-2022 mint with mintAuthority 3t3X4xqXbRDksat5cPjfHoWftvTwpHEj9c7tWMVvNPAh. The authority account parses as an initialized Token-2022 multisig requiring 1 of 3 valid signers; it can authorize direct minting without an on-chain numeric cap.

controls.label: EUROP XRPL issuer account
controls.evidence: Schuman's official deployment page identifies rMkEuRii9w9uBMQDnWV5AA43gvYZR9JxVK as the XRPL EUROP issuer account. XRPL issued-token supply is controlled by the issuer account rather than an upgradeable EVM token contract.

review.evidence: Pinned reads cover every current EUROP deployment. Ethereum, Polygon, Avalanche, and Plasma use UUPS token proxies with chain-local owner/admin and MASTER_MINTER_ROLE Safes; XRPL uses Schuman's issuer account. At finalized Solana slot 434569236, the Token-2022 mint authority is an initialized 1-of-3 multisig. All reviewed issuance surfaces are economically unbounded issuer controls. The ESMA interim MiCA register lists SALVUS (trading as Schuman Financial) with ACPR as competent authority, and Schuman identifies the issuer as an ACPR-licensed electronic money institution.
